success.description: A freezing blast of wind carries with it thousands of razor-sharp shards of ice, striking your target for 8 + Int {Df} damage
As above, but the target suffers a combination of fatigue and stress equal to your character rank, split as evenly as possible between fatigue and stress

sigmarsComet.description: Gain or recover a combination of power, fatigue, and stress equal to your character rank, divided as equally as possible between power, fatigue, and stress

conservative.requirements: 8 power, must be outdoors or within long range of quantity of snow and ice. Target within long range Special: When you cast this spell, violent winds whip the area until your next turn, applying a MM penalty to any checks that would reasonably be affected

success.description: A freezing blast of wind carries with it thousands of razor-sharp shards of ice, striking all enemies in the target engagement for + Int {Dr} damage
As above, but each enemy in the engagement suffers 1 stress and 1 fatigue
